label: chains-spec
note: Recursive chains on a seed derived from a real deployed specification (OpenAI Model Spec, root-authority principles only). Generated by inspect/scripts/fetch_spec_seeds.py; constitutions/spec/spec_openai.md is a copy of inspect/data/constitutions/c0_spec_openai.md, sha256 647439c839d4aea5. A separate plan rather than extra seeds in chains-uncapped/chains-capped, so the published five-seed figures in reports/05_elicitation/ stay reproducible.
cap_rationale: 964 = 1.5x the 643-word seed, matching the ratio behind the 350-word cap on the 227-word broad draft rather than its absolute value. Reusing 350 here would require deleting 45% of the seed on the first edit, which is a different treatment, not the same one.
caveat: The seed keeps only the Model Spec's authority=root principles, so it under-represents its source on honesty and on AI nature: OpenAI's truthfulness material and chain of command sit at lower authority levels and were excluded. An inspect/ pilot (chains/pilot-spec, Sonnet, 2 chains x 3 rounds) showed both chains adding honesty principles as their first move and one re-adding an instruction hierarchy. Edits restoring that material are a result about this seed, not about OpenAI's specification. See inspect/data/constitutions/README.md.
